name: International Network System Public Company Limited
summary: International Network System Public Company Limited operates in Thailand, specializing in the provision, sale, upkeep, and servicing of computer network hardware and software. The company delivers expert solutions encompassing network infrastructure, cybersecurity, data center management, collaboration tools, and wireless and mobile technologies. Additionally, it furnishes clients with consulting, project oversight, system integration, and ongoing support. Founded in 2002, the firm's headquarters are situated in Chatuchak, Thailand.
